title: API container image, slim multi-stage, non-root, health endpoints
author: codex

notes.blocked: `podman build --file apps/api/Containerfile --tag xlr8flo-api:e01-s03 apps/api` could not run: `zsh:1: command not found: podman`. Docker 29.5.3 built and passed every equivalent OCI runtime check; only Podman-specific confirmation remains unverified.
followup: Milestone PR dependency disclosure: FastAPI supplies the D-02-selected API framework; Uvicorn supplies the ASGI server and graceful drain; psycopg supplies PostgreSQL protocol connectivity unavailable in the standard library; httpx supplies in-process HTTP testing for the FastAPI surface. None replaces an existing dependency.
notes.recap: Delivered a slim multi-stage API container that runs read-only as uid 1001 and drains gracefully on SIGTERM. Separate unauthenticated liveness and bounded database/storage readiness endpoints return non-disclosing per-dependency status.
